# canary order --help · COLUMNS=80 · colour off
canary order — Preview, place, change, cancel or check orders

Usage: canary order <action> [flags]

Actions
  preview           Check an order at IB Gateway without placing it
  status            Read one order from the local journal
  place             Submit an eligible preview through the trading gates
  modify            Replace an order using an eligible preview
  cancel            Request an order cancellation through the trading gates
  tws-cancel        Cancel an order placed by hand in TWS over a client-0
                    connection (it becomes an API order)
  tws-modify        Change the quantity or limit of a DAY limit order placed by
                    hand in TWS over a client-0 connection

Every build previews. place, modify, cancel, tws-cancel and tws-modify need the
trading build; the standard build refuses them before anything is sent.

Run canary order <action> --help for syntax and flags.

                    connection (it becomes an API order)
  \x1b[36mtws-modify        \x1b[0mChange the quantity or limit of a DAY limit order placed by
                    hand in TWS over a client-0 connection

Run canary order <action> --help for syntax and flags.
